subject: Request: One-time pilot credits + POC extension for Atlas Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time pilot credits & 4-week POC extension for Atlas Health

Jasmine,

Quick ask: Atlas Health (Samir Patel) is running into token runway constraints on their pilot. They're a mid-stage healthcare analytics startup evaluating our private deployment for Q4 procurement. The deal is not yet closed but expected to reach $450k ARR in year 1 if the pilot shows latency/cost parity.

Current situation:
- Standard PLG free credits exhausted after their third week of testing.
- They need an extra ~500k tokens to finish a biometric signal ingestion test and an extra 4 weeks to finish integration.

Request:
- One-time credit grant of 500,000 tokens (hosted API) beyond standard limits
- Extend the POC an additional 30 days

Why approve:
- High technical fit (requires our low-latency batch routing), strong likelihood to convert
- Procurement timeline is tight; PO expected within 6 weeks after successful POC

Attachments: Atlas_POC_SOW.pdf (scope & acceptance criteria)

Would appreciate an exec signoff or guidance on a counter-proposal we can present. If the ask is too large, we can propose 300k tokens and 30 days instead.

Thanks,

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0193
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: one-time pilot credits & 4-week POC extension for Atlas Health

Vivek — forwarding Marissa's note. TL;DR: Atlas is asking for a 500k token top-up + 30-day extension. Marissa suggests a conservative counter of 300k tokens + 30 days if you want to limit exposure.

For context: Atlas has already run ingestion tests that validated our latency at their 99th percentile. They are constrained by contract terms on their side (procurement needs demonstration artifacts). If we can give a small runway and a documented acceptance window, we expect a PO within 6 weeks.

Two quick questions for you: 1) Are you comfortable approving a one-time credit outside PLG limits? 2) Any conditions we should attach (usage cap, logging/audit requirement, signed addendum)?

If you prefer, I can draft a short addendum and a HubSpot note for the finance checklist.

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 510 555 0124

Thanks for the context. Approve with guardrails.

Decision (one-time, non-recurring):
- Grant 300,000 tokens to Atlas Health (hosted API) as a one-time pilot top-up.
- Approve a 30-day POC extension (effective from the date Atlas accepts the addendum).

Conditions:
1) Signed addendum (DocuSign) capturing the extension and acceptance criteria before credits are applied.
2) Usage capped to 300k tokens; any overage will be billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates.
3) Add HubSpot note with deal_id RDW-52731 and tag finance for tracking; Marissa to attach Atlas_POC_SOW.pdf and the addendum.
4) This is a single exception — not to be used as precedent without formal Deal Desk approval.

Please implement and confirm once DocuSign is out. Marissa — route the addendum to contracts@atlashealth.ai and cc finance-ops@redwood.ai.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 650 555 0177
